note:
The Support > Contact menu tile has no purpose-made photograph. It currently borrows a bathroom-vanity product lifestyle shot, and the only file named for the job, skingenetix-contact-banner.jpg, is unusable: the generation brief is printed across the frame and an unbranded competitor-looking bottle is in shot.

Malcolm's brief: a dermatologist in a white coat talking with a client, close-up head shot. Four compositions so the choice is real, each on every supplier.

NO REFERENCE IMAGE IS SENT. Nothing branded is in frame, and a reference pulls the framing back to its own camera distance - the opposite of what a close two-shot needs. For the same reason no product is described: a described product is a product that gets drawn, and a drawn product gets an invented label.

The tile renders as a 232px square, delivered at 560px, so the faces must read at thumbnail size. That is why every slot is a tight two-shot and none of them is a wide consulting-room scene.

Edge conditions are stated rather than left implied - 'quiet upper third' has previously come back as a black bar across a forehead. Text is negated hard: a white coat invites an embroidered name, and an embroidered name on a tile is an invented brand.

defaults.negative_global: text, lettering, embroidered name, logo, badge, watermark, signature, border, collage, multi-panel, cartoon, illustration, plastic waxy skin

slots.title: Clinician listening, client's shoulder in soft foreground
slots.prompt:
A photorealistic square editorial photograph of a consultation between a skin clinician and a client, shot as a tight close two-shot.

The clinician is a woman in her early forties with warm mid-brown skin and dark hair drawn back, wearing a plain white cotton clinical coat over a soft grey top. Her collar and the top of her shoulders are visible at the lower edge of the frame; the coat is completely plain, with no pocket badge, no embroidery, no printed characters of any kind anywhere on it. Her head occupies roughly the right half of the frame, from about 0.45 to 0.88 of the frame width and from about 0.12 to 0.68 of the frame height. She is turned about twenty degrees away from the camera toward the left of frame, looking at the client, listening rather than speaking - lips closed, eyebrows relaxed, a small attentive warmth around the eyes. Her eyes are in sharp focus.

In the near foreground at the left edge, the back of the client's head and one shoulder are visible, cropped by the left edge of the frame and reaching from the bottom edge up to about 0.55 of the frame height, occupying roughly the left quarter of the frame. The client is rendered soft and out of focus so the clinician's face is unambiguously the subject; only the outline of hair and shoulder reads, no facial features.

Both people show real, unretouched skin - visible pores, fine lines at the outer eye, faint natural colour variation - lit so that texture is present without being emphasised.

Lighting is a large, soft, north-facing window source from the front-left, giving gentle directional modelling and no hard shadow edges. Behind them is a clean, out-of-focus pale room: warm off-white and soft grey, no furniture reading as a recognisable object, no signage, no artwork, nothing carrying a character or a symbol. The background occupies the whole upper right of the frame and stays quiet and even all the way to the top edge and the right edge - no dark band, no vignette, no gradient sweeping across the top.

Colour is calm and clinical-warm: white, warm off-white, soft grey, and natural skin tones only. Shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2.0, natural colour, no filter, magazine-quality editorial photography.

slots.title: Clinician mid-sentence, client's face partly visible
slots.prompt:
A photorealistic square editorial photograph of a skin clinician explaining something to a client, shot as a tight close two-shot with both faces in frame.

On the left, the clinician is a man in his late thirties with light-olive skin and short dark hair, wearing a plain white cotton clinical coat over a pale blue collarless shirt. The coat is completely plain - no pocket badge, no embroidery, no printed characters of any kind. His head sits from about 0.08 to 0.48 of the frame width and from about 0.14 to 0.66 of the frame height. He is turned toward the client at the right, mid-sentence with his lips parted, an open and unhurried expression. His near eye is in sharp focus.

On the right, the client is a woman in her fifties with fair skin and grey-blonde hair, seen in three-quarter profile from about 0.55 to 0.95 of the frame width, listening, a faint smile beginning. She is very slightly softer in focus than the clinician but her features read clearly. She wears a plain warm-grey knit; no jewellery, no pattern, no visible fastening.

Both people show real, unretouched skin - visible pores, fine lines, faint natural colour variation, a few small natural marks - lit so that texture is present without being emphasised. Neither face is smoothed.

Lighting is a large, soft, north-facing window source from the front-left, gentle directional modelling and no hard shadow edges. Between and behind their heads the background is a clean, out-of-focus pale room in warm off-white and soft grey, with nothing in it that reads as a recognisable object, and no signage, artwork, character or symbol anywhere. The background stays quiet and even all the way to the top edge and both side edges - no dark band across the top, no vignette.

Colour is calm and clinical-warm: white, warm off-white, soft grey, and natural skin tones only. Shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2.2, natural colour, no filter, magazine-quality editorial photography.

slots.title: Over the client's shoulder onto the clinician
slots.prompt:
A photorealistic square editorial photograph taken over a client's shoulder, looking at the skin clinician facing them across a consultation.

The clinician is a woman in her mid-thirties with deep-brown skin and short natural hair, wearing a plain white cotton clinical coat over a cream top. The coat is completely plain - no pocket badge, no embroidery, no printed characters of any kind. She faces almost straight toward the camera, her head from about 0.34 to 0.76 of the frame width and from about 0.10 to 0.62 of the frame height, speaking warmly with her lips slightly parted and direct, friendly eye contact past the camera toward the client. Her eyes are in sharp focus.

The client is present only as a large, deliberately out-of-focus dark shoulder and the edge of a head occupying the bottom-left corner, entering from the bottom edge and the left edge and reaching to about 0.40 of the frame width and about 0.38 of the frame height. It reads as a soft dark mass framing the lower left corner, with no facial features and no detail.

The clinician's skin is real and unretouched - visible pores, natural fine lines, faint colour variation - lit so texture is present without being emphasised.

Lighting is a large, soft window source from the front-right, giving gentle directional modelling across her face and no hard shadow edges. Behind her is a clean, out-of-focus pale room in warm off-white and soft grey, with nothing that reads as a recognisable object, and no signage, artwork, character or symbol anywhere. The background stays quiet and even all the way to the top edge and both side edges - no dark band across the top, no vignette.

Colour is calm and clinical-warm: white, warm off-white, soft grey, and natural skin tones only. Shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2.0, natural colour, no filter, magazine-quality editorial photography.

slots.title: Side by side, clinician gesturing toward the client's cheek
slots.prompt:
A photorealistic square editorial photograph of a skin clinician and a client seated close together, the clinician indicating an area of the client's cheek as she speaks.

On the right, the clinician is a woman in her forties with fair skin and dark brown hair tied back, wearing a plain white cotton clinical coat over a plain white top. The coat is completely plain - no pocket badge, no embroidery, no printed characters of any kind. Her head sits from about 0.52 to 0.90 of the frame width and from about 0.10 to 0.60 of the frame height, turned toward the client at the left, speaking gently.

On the left, the client is a woman in her early thirties with warm brown skin and dark wavy hair, seen in three-quarter view from about 0.10 to 0.50 of the frame width, her face lifted slightly toward the clinician, calm and attentive. Her face is in sharp focus and is the brighter of the two.

The clinician's near hand is raised into the lower middle of the frame, held about a hand's width clear of the client's cheek and not touching it, index finger extended in a light indicating gesture. The hand has exactly five fingers, correctly proportioned, and is not obscuring either face.

Both people show real, unretouched skin - visible pores, fine lines, faint natural colour variation - lit so texture is present without being emphasised.

Lighting is a large, soft window source from the front-left, giving gentle directional modelling and no hard shadow edges. Behind them the background is a clean, out-of-focus pale room in warm off-white and soft grey, with nothing that reads as a recognisable object, and no signage, artwork, character or symbol anywhere. It stays quiet and even all the way to the top edge and both side edges - no dark band across the top, no vignette.

Colour is calm and clinical-warm: white, warm off-white, soft grey, and natural skin tones only. Shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2.2, natural colour, no filter, magazine-quality editorial photography.
